landing.title: Group Reservation
landing.subtitle: Reserve a table for your group of 7-14 people
landing.description: Welcome to our group reservation system. Please read the following information carefully before proceeding.

rules.title: Important Information
rules.groupSize: This reservation system is for groups of 7 to 14 people only.
rules.fixedSlots: All group reservations are for fixed time slots.
rules.menuRequired: Group menu is mandatory. À la carte (individual ordering) is not available for groups.
rules.deposit: A credit card is required to guarantee your reservation.
rules.noShowPolicy: A fee of $20 CAD per person applies for no-shows or cancellations within 48 hours.

smallGroup.title: For 1-6 Guests
smallGroup.description: Please use our regular booking system for smaller groups.

largeGroup.title: For 15+ Guests
largeGroup.description: Please contact us directly for large group arrangements.

landing.agreement: I have read and understand the group reservation policies

details.title: Date, Time & Contact
details.subtitle: Step 2 of 6

time.label: Select Time Slot
time.lateWarning: Late arrivals may result in reduced dining time

details.depositNotice: Reservation is confirmed only after completing the final step.

menuPolicy.title: Menu Policy
menuPolicy.subtitle: Step 3 of 6
menuPolicy.description: Please review our group menu policy before proceeding.

rules.title: Group Menu Rules
rules.mandatory: Group menu is mandatory for all reservations of 7+ people.
rules.noAlaCarte: À la carte (individual ordering) is not available for groups.
rules.menuTypes: You may mix different menus (Half-Moon, Full-Moon, Vegetarian).
rules.minimumOrder: Minimum 2 people required per menu type.
rules.children: Children under 10 may order 1 dish from the menu.

menuPolicy.agreement: I understand and accept the group menu policy

allergy.title: Allergy Information
allergy.subtitle: Step 4 of 6
allergy.description: Please inform us of any allergies or dietary restrictions in your group.
allergy.question: Does anyone in your group have allergies or dietary restrictions?

details.label: Please describe the allergies and indicate how many people are affected
details.placeholder: e.g., 2 guests have nut allergies, 1 guest is vegetarian...

warnings.title: Important Allergen Information
warnings.peanuts: Peanuts: May be present in our kitchen. Guests with severe allergies should reconsider dining with us.
warnings.fishGluten: Fish/Gluten: Our meat marinades contain soy sauce and fish sauce. Please inform us in advance if you cannot consume these.

houseRules.title: House Rules
houseRules.subtitle: Step 5 of 6
houseRules.description: Please agree to the following policies to complete your reservation.

headcount.title: Final Headcount
headcount.description: Please confirm the exact number of guests 48 hours before your visit.

oneBill.title: One Bill Policy
oneBill.description: We provide one bill per table. Separate bills are not available.

noOutside.title: No Outside Items
noOutside.description: Outside food, drinks, desserts, decorations, and music equipment are not permitted.

alcohol.title: Alcohol Policy
alcohol.description: Beverages over 20% alcohol are not permitted. Wine and beer only.

houseRules.agreement: I agree to all house rules listed above

cardGuarantee.title: Card Guarantee
cardGuarantee.subtitle: Step 6 of 6
cardGuarantee.description: Please provide a credit card to guarantee your reservation.

notice.secure: Your card is securely saved for reservation guarantee only.
notice.penalty: A fee of $20 CAD per person applies only if you cancel within 48 hours or fail to show up.

cardGuarantee.agreement: I understand and accept the cancellation policy

confirmation.title: Reservation Confirmed!
confirmation.subtitle: Thank you for your reservation

reminderItems.cancellation: Cancel at least 48 hours in advance to avoid penalties

errors.slotUnavailable: This time slot is no longer available
errors.capacityExceeded: Sorry, we cannot accommodate this group size at this time
errors.bookingFailed: Failed to create reservation. Please try again.
